Description
WEST END / YALETOWN 1000 BEACH - Fully renovated with top of the line finishing and appliances approx 2 years ago. Prestigious 1000 Beach Avenue . Fully renovated two years ago . Spectacular 1,202 sqft 2 bedroom 2 bath corner suite with incredible ocean and harbour views! Impressive features include large master bedroom with big ensuite , bright kitchen with lots of windows and Quartz counters ,generous size dining room & living room with gas fireplace will easily accommodate larger furniture. Relax in the 7,000 sqft Health Club with glass bottom pool, hot tub, sauna, fitness centre & squash court. Building has 24 hour security & concierge and as an added bonus this suite has 2 side by side parking stalls & a storage locker. Ideal location steps to shopping, seawall, and restaurants
